thread:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — multiple nodes in inference-pool-us-west-2 reporting NotReady (kubelet restarts). Auto-escalation to on-call. Pager: paging ash.

ash: acknowledging, on my way. any impact to production traffic?

maria: seeing spike in 503s for /v1/chat and p99 latency jumps to ~3.2s for embeddings. Dashboard shows ~6 nodes NotReady in the pool over the last 3m.

kevin: interesting — kubelet journal on one affected node shows repeated segfaults in device-plugin init and then systemd restarting kubelet:

```
Mar 14 10:45:12 ip-10-0-1-23 kubelet[1234]: runtime error: invalid memory address
Mar 14 10:45:12 ip-10-0-1-23 kubelet[1234]: goroutine 1 [running]:
Mar 14 10:45:12 ip-10-0-1-23 kubelet[1234]: deviceplugin.Init(0x0)
Mar 14 10:45:12 ip-10-0-1-23 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: main process exited, code=exited, status=2/INVALIDARG
Mar 14 10:45:12 ip-10-0-1-23 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Failed with result 'exit-code'.
```

ash: noted. any node-level OOMs or GPU driver errors?

maria: GPU drivers look OK on healthy nodes. On affected nodes dmesg shows repeated `nvlink` timeouts and `nvidia-mig` complaining before kubelet died. Not full OOM, but device plugin couldn't enumerate GPUs.

ops: paging log shows autoscaler tried to replace nodes but new node boot succeeded then joined but pods kept failing with `FailedScheduling: no nodes available with taint` — looks like taint from our drain hooks.

ash: immediate plan: 1) cordon the currently NotReady nodes so they don't receive new pods 2) trigger a soft drain on nodes that are Unhealthy to force failover 3) scale up inference-pool fallback capacity in another AZ/region 4) apply routing fallback to cpu-quantized model variants for high-risk customers.

kevin: executing cordon/drain on the 6 nodes now. running:
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-1-23
kubectl drain ip-10-0-1-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

maria: note — some pods are PDB-protected (critical). we'll rely on our smart-routing to reduce traffic and avoid violating PDBs. I'm toggling canaries to reroute non-critical routes.

deploybot: :gear: Canary routing update applied: routes for `public-search` and `realtime-chat` now favor inference-pool-us-east-1. Latency threshold holdback set to 500ms.

ash: triggering a rolling restart of device-plugin DaemonSet in the pool to pick up any bound GPU changes. command:
```
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-device-plugin -n infra-inference
```

kevin: restarted device-plugin on two nodes. logs now show successful plugin registration on node ip-10-0-2-41. However ip-10-0-1-23 still fails with `device lookup timeout`.

maria: customer impact estimate: about 8% of requests are failing or hitting 2x latency in the us-west-2 pool. Top affected customers: Surveyly (API requests), Acme Metrics (batch embeddings). I've DM'd Customer Success for proactive emails.

ash: outreach: @maria please post incident banner on status.redwood and flag support playbook. Also create a page in incidents/ with timeline.

maria: on it. posting banner now.

ops: autoscaler report: launched 4 nodes in us-east-1 and one in us-west-2 (replacement). New nodes healthy; scheduler scoring is preferring us-east due to zone weighting.

kevin: still seeing kubelet restarts on a small subset — suspicion: corrupted device-plugin config after last infra deploy. rolling back device-plugin to the previous image tag `v1.3.7` as a mitigation.

ash: go ahead with rollback. keep me posted every 5m. if nodes recover, we'll uncordon slowly.

deploybot: rollback started: daemonset/gpu-device-plugin -> image:registry/redwood/device-plugin:v1.3.7

maria: quick assessment: once device-plugin rolled back, 4 nodes re-registered and pods re-scheduled. Errors on the 2 oldest nodes persisted — plan to repro those via maintenance window (reboot).

ash: status update for page: primary mitigation applied (rollback + cordon/drain), routing fallback active, autoscaler added capacity in alternate region. Impact reduced from 8% failing to ~1.2% degraded. Preparing handoff.

kevin: running controlled reboot on the two stubborn nodes now (`sudo reboot`) — will monitor kubelet on boot.

ash: handoff to kevin for post-mitigation monitoring for next 2 hours. I'll remain available for escalations. Logging final notes in incident doc.

maria: I sent the proactive customer email drafts to CS. Also flagged a regression ticket for the device-plugin release pipeline.

sre-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident P1 closed to active mitigation state. Follow-ups created: INF-7623 (device-plugin release rollback investigation), INF-7624 (add kubelet health probe aggregation), INF-7625 (improve cross-AZ fallback routing).

kevin: last check — p99 latency back to baseline, no new NotReady events in last 8m. closing watch but will keep metrics dashboard pinned.

ash: thanks team. final: uncordon nodes only after kubelet stable for 10m and pods are Healthy. Good job. :thumbsup:
